derivation:
by
  rw [Subgroup.strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_one_of_T_mem (translation_mem_GammaH M H)]
  exact AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples _
explanation: The Mathlib declaration identifies the strict periods of any subgroup of SL(2, ℤ) containing T with the integer multiples of 1. Instantiating it with CohCarrier.GammaH M H gives the result, since 1 belongs to its own integer multiples.
